account.welcomeTitle: Ku soo dhawoow! Akkaawntigaagu diyaar ayey tahay.
account.welcomeBody: Hoos ku xidh Telegram si aad u xaqiijiso akoonkaaga oo aad u hesho updates. Kadib dooro meesha aad rabto inaad ka bilawdo.
account.findHealerBody: Baadh businesses la xaqiijiyay oo book waqti kuu habboon.
account.listYourBusinessBody: Daaweynihii, akhristayaasha, farshaxanleyda iyo adeegaha xafladaha halkan ayay ku shaqeeyaan.
account.startCaseBody: Tababare ayaa xaaladdaada baariyaa oo kaaga soo qora warbixin.
account.connectTelegram: Xaqiiji akoonkaaga, gal hal gujin, oo hel casriyeyn, farriimaha dib-u-eegaha, bookiga, iyo links-ka password reset-ka Telegram.
account.sendNotificationsBody: Updatesyada kiis, farriimaha dib-u-eegaha, bookiga iyo lacagta.
account.tapToConfirm: Taabo badhanka oo xaqiiji Telegram. Waxaan kaliya helnaa magacaaga iyo aqoonsiga Telegram.

business.createListing: Abuur liis gudaha daqiiqado. Ku dar adeegyo iyo saacadaha furan, ka dib codso xaqiijin si aad ugu muuqato marketplace.
